text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's another day, and Sakura Bakushin O
is still
dutifully carrying out her Bakushin
Greetings.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!
Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Me? Hard at work? Why, yes! It's
exactly as
you say!
choice_data_list: おはよう、今日も頑張ってるな
おはよう、今日も頑張ってるね

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin is a virtue! And I'm getting
quite the
hang of this greeting business!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're at it again today, I see.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Air Groove! Gooood morning!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I came to have another look at things. I'll
just be
off to the side, so pay me no
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious to see what kind of effect my
advice
has had on the campaign, so I
decide to stick
around too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Bourbon! You've arrived
at the
exact same time as yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. Yes, I follow an optimally

coordinated daily routine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Bamboo! Did you
manage to go
partner running with Inari
yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Bakushin O! You know I did!
I'm super
pumped today and ready to
take on the world!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I see you over there! Good
morning!

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
G-good morning! You seem cheerful as
usual.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The class representative is always
cheerful! More
importantly, you're
running in your first
scrimmage today,
aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah—don't worry, I know exactly what
you're
looking for! A few exuberant
cheers of
encouragement from this class
rep, am I right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Go and get 'em! You can do it! You can
win! All
you need is Bakushin! Bakushin
to victory!

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. I feel more confident now! Thank
you! I'll
do my best!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You have quite the memory. I can't
believe you
remember everyone's arrival
times and even knew
she'd be running
her first scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Once I started greeting
everyone each
morning, I naturally
began to remember more and
more
about them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Being here makes it a lot easier for me
to praise
everyone for doing so well in
their daily lives!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's fun for me too! Everyone's so happy
and full
of energy, which makes greeting
them all the
more rewarding!
choice_data_list: 確かにみんな嬉しそうだった

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This was a great chance for me to
reacquaint
myself with everyone! I forgot
Tracen Academy
had so many students!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It seems your Bakushin Greeting
initiative is
going well then.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You're absolutely correct! And it's all
because I'm
able to inject everyone with
a healthy dose of
Bakushin energy with
my greetings!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That's all well and fine too, but what I was actually commending was your growth, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Me?! But I'm the class rep. I thought my
only duty
was to work selflessly for
others?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense. You've shown that you can
look at
each student and see them as
individuals...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That is a difficult—but important—lesson
for
anyone who leads, especially a class

representative.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But you managed to do just that,
Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying even though I'm already
perfect as
class representative, I've
managed to grow even
more?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Greeting lots of people sure is
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So amazing, in fact—oops! I completely
forgot
something, despite how amazing I
am!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Good morning! Welcome back to school!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After receiving such an invigorating
morning
greeting, I get the feeling
today's going to be a
pretty good day!
